_comment: The routing table, as data. Authoritative for routing: which question reaches which
pattern, which templates it uses, what capability gates it, and when to stop.
The prose in references/patterns/ is the depth behind each entry, and
references/analysis-patterns.md is the index a reader browses. Neither is generated -
this skill ships no runtime and cannot run a generator - so the suite tests them
against this file instead: every pattern here has a file that exists and appears in
the index, and every template named here is in the query catalogue. A pattern that
names a template nobody ships is a routing instruction to nowhere.
`capabilities` lists what the pattern's templates need, so a planner can say 'this
dataset cannot answer that' before running anything. It is advisory here: the
authoritative gate is the query catalogue's own `requires`, checked at render time.

impact-and-dependency.title: Impact and dependency
stop_when: the relationship semantics on a path stop supporting the claim
reachability has been established but criticality has not - they are different questions
the next hop needs data the models do not carry, such as traffic or failure history

traceability.title: Traceability
stop_when: no cross-layer relationship type exists in this dataset, which is a finding
a missing link has been identified - report it separately from a negative assertion

coverage-and-gaps.title: Coverage and gaps
stop_when: the population is empty, which produces zero gaps and looks like perfect coverage
the gap concentrates in one model, which is a partial export rather than an ownership problem

governance-and-decisions.title: Governance and decisions
stop_when: no predicate in this dataset carries decisions or policies at all
the only status found describes the conversion rather than the architecture

lifecycle-and-portfolio.title: Lifecycle and portfolio comparison
stop_when: equivalence rests on labels alone - say the question is not answerable yet
lifecycle is absent for most of the population, so the listed subset is not a portfolio view

cross-notation.title: Cross-notation questions
stop_when: identity-audit is refused, which means the dataset has no reconciliation and the join cannot be made
only label candidates remain - report them as candidates and stop

views-and-documentation.title: Views and documentation
stop_when: the notation carries no diagrams at all, which is always true of Backstage and LeanIX
a difference between diagrams has been found - it is not yet a difference in the architecture

model-contents.title: What a model contains
stop_when: the model is drawn at a level of detail that hides what was asked about
a participant has been listed - that is a drawn intent, not a running system

model-quality.title: Model quality
stop_when: the question turns out to be about conformance against shapes - hand it to linked-archi-validate
a verdict is available but its target-class coverage is not, which makes the verdict unreadable
